title: Split progress and report
summary: What happens after the split gate. Each part shows its outcome (decided, answered, pending, settled by a human, not settled, not run), its child record link and dependency order. Cards: hand split, mid-run split, research split, a partial run (budget stop, dependants not run, one part still decided), a rejected split kept whole (run not blocked), and a rejected split that ends blocked.

provenance.note: Drafted from leafcutter/decisions Decomposition records; styled from the Atlas tokens via docs/ui-context.md (globals.css, tailwind.config.ts, layout.tsx, kit.tsx).
Decisions v4: split also offered when routing would accept the request (bundled_accepted); reject depends on the trigger.
Decisions v5: seven-part bundled_accepted gate sample with read-only not-covered parts; partial-run card (budget stop, dependants not run).
